title: PostgreSQL for Everything
summary: An article advocating for PostgreSQL as a universal database solution that can replace multiple specialized databases, covering its lesser-known features like JSON support, full-text search, and advanced indexing capabilities.
problem_solved: Reduces architectural complexity by eliminating the need for multiple specialized databases (Redis, Elasticsearch, etc.) in favor of a single, powerful relational database.
why_valuable: PostgreSQL's extensive feature set allows teams to simplify their tech stack while maintaining high performance, reducing operational overhead and maintenance costs.
